QuestInfo.0: They say that you can receive the #b<Mushroom Kingdom Guardian>#k title from Mush King by assisting the Mushroom Kingdom and rescuing Princess Violetta.
QuestInfo.1: If you solve the Mushking Empire's troubles and save Princess Violetta, you might get the #b<Mushking Empire Guardian>#k title from the Mushking...
